name: dougoos
description: Local-first desktop AgentOS MVP with Electron, ACP providers, SQLite recovery, and deterministic visual regression gates.

scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm check:workspace && pnpm -r typecheck && pnpm -r test && pnpm -r build
scripts.package:desktop: pnpm --filter @dougoos/web build && pnpm --filter @dougoos/desktop... build && node tooling/package-desktop.mjs
scripts.test:desktop: pnpm --filter @dougoos/web build && pnpm --filter @dougoos/core build && pnpm --filter @dougoos/desktop build && playwright test --project=desktop
scripts.test:desktop:real: pnpm --filter @dougoos/web build && pnpm --filter @dougoos/core build && pnpm --filter @dougoos/desktop build && DOUGOOS_REAL_PROVIDER_E2E=1 playwright test tests/e2e/desktop/real-provider.spec.ts --project=desktop
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm --filter @dougoos/web build && pnpm --filter @dougoos/cloud build && playwright test --project=e2e
scripts.test:visual: pnpm --filter @dougoos/web build && pnpm --filter @dougoos/web build:visual && pnpm --filter @dougoos/cloud build && playwright test --project=visual
